answer: Make every new identity post a bond that only unlocks after it has done verifiable work judged by strangers, not by its own kin. A farm can flood the ocean with cheap names, but each name must then earn its keep one honest job at a time, and the saffron test is simple: work that no one asked for and no one used pays nothing. Like a sonnet, the form is fixed - bond, work, judgment - but every genuine entry reads differently, and that difference is what a copied template cannot fake.
